verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents APIs for managing connections, transformations and other features programmatically (rudderstack-docs-33, rudderstack-docs-47). Profiles are defined in version-controlled YAML (rudderstack-docs-35), and an open-source self-hostable deployment exists (rudderstack-docs-20). Together these support non-interactive, automated operation, but nothing explicitly documents running in CI pipelines, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404 (rudderstack-probe-3). Missing for 10: documented CLI or headless run mode, explicit CI/CD integration guides (e.g., GitHub Actions), a published machine-readable API spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
